crossRefs.note: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving…
Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that Yahweh’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and…
They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master.…
Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Yahweh’s glory…
So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was…
He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and…
Moreover the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward. Behold…
The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision…
In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was…
The Spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.
When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more…
I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head…
I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…
